adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Fat malabsorption, acanthocytosis, extremely low triglyceride/LDL/apoB, and biallelic MTTP variants identify abetalipoproteinemia. MTTP is required to lipidate nascent apoB during chylomicron/VLDL assembly in the ER.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: LPL/ApoC-II acts after triglyceride-rich particles enter plasma; LDL receptor mediates uptake; LCAT and ABCA1 are HDL/cholesterol pathways. None substitutes for MTTP-dependent apoB particle assembly.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The strongest alternative would require a disorder of lipoprotein catabolism or HDL formation, but the genotype and near-absence of apoB-containing particles specifically localize the defect to assembly/secretion.
